_doc: THE declared pattern set of rule 'G0 _ Auth' (Ga Code, Gb Link to auth, Gc No Auth). One source, two derivations: _shared/lib/derive-mail-rules.ts turns it into the maddy-sorter's G0 axis rules (header_contains on Subject), and the Cloud Mail app's AuthClassifier is built from a vendored copy of this file (ac_cloud-mail/core/data/src/main/resources/auth-patterns.json in cloud-u-android, held equal by AuthPatternsParityTest). Change a phrase HERE, re-derive, and re-vendor; the parity tests fail on either side that did not follow. The server sees headers only (the sorter reads msgs.cachedHeader), so its Ga/Gb are decided on the Subject; the app also reads the preview/body, where Ga is decided by the reading pane's code extractor and Gb additionally by url_tokens in links.
